judul: Onna Majutsushi-san, Moto no Sekai e Kaeru Tame ni Ganbarimasu
author: IMAKI Ten [Add, ]
synopsis: Rintaro and Haruto are 2 friends who enjoy playing VRMMO Eternal Maze Online, a fantasy video game where you can be a different person from the real world and have a second life. One day Rintaro finds a mysterious item called the Resurrection Jewel in his inventory so he decides to use it and teleports himself and his friend to the fantasy world. Rintaro will play his female avatar who is a magician and Haruto in his male avatar a strong paladin.
